title: ProgressEvent
description: Typed JSON payload (the SSE 'data:' line) for events emitted on POST /query when streamProgress=true. The SSE 'event:' line names the variant (progress | done | error). Each variant is validated against the corresponding $defs entry. Progress events are emitted zero or more times during a fresh model run; a single terminal done event carries the full VerifiedResponse; an error event may terminate the stream with a typed ApiError. Cache hits emit a single done event with no preceding progress events. See docs/contracts/code-gen-guide.md section Server-Sent Events for the wire format and docs/contracts/frontend-components.md for the StageStatus consumer.

ProgressVariant.description: SSE 'event: progress' payload. Emitted at the start of each substantive pipeline stage during a fresh run. Never emitted on a cache hit.

stage.description: Canonical stage identifier. Matches the run-trace.schema.json stages enum subset that represents substantive pipeline work (cache_lookup and cache_store are recorded in the run trace but never surfaced as progress events to keep cache hits non-leaky).

elapsedMs.description: Cumulative milliseconds since request receipt, measured server-side. Monotonic across events within a single run. The client may layer its own arrival timestamp on top (for UI freshness signals) but should not reorder events by client time.

modelRouteId.description: Optional. Certified ModelRoute.routeId for stages that called a provider (typically a1_a2_query_analyzer, a5_composer, and the optional a6_verifier judge). Omitted for deterministic stages (a3_retrieval, a4_evidence_packager) and when the run path did not invoke a model.

DoneVariant.description: SSE 'event: done' payload. Emitted exactly once at the terminal stage of every run (fresh or cache hit). The payload is the full VerifiedResponse including citations, runTrace, and verification.passed.

ErrorVariant.description: SSE 'event: error' payload. Emitted at most once and terminates the stream. The shape is the standard ApiError envelope so client error handling is uniform across the JSON-response and SSE-response paths.
